name: Bernardo Heights Sides Open 2022
information:
## This competition does *not* have 3x3x3 Cube - check out [Marshall Cubing September 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MarshallCubingSeptember2022) or [Diamond Bar September 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DiamondBarSeptember2022) for 3x3x3 Cube instead!

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BernardoHeightsSidesOpen2022#21103-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Please provide adult supervision for children under 12 years of age.
